periods.label: 支持一辉的学生会成员

status.current: watches Ikki and Stella's final with the student council

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Former selection opponent; believes his technique can overcome Stella's violence because she fought him herself.
relationships.ikazuchi-saijo: Debates speed versus power with him on the way to the venue.

periods.summary: Renren arrives in Osaka with Saijo and Utakata for the final. She argues that Ikki can win because his technique once redirected her supersonic Black Bird and because speed should decide modern combat. She later celebrates Ikki from the stands and appears among those congratulating him during the ceremony.

key_events.summary: Debates the likely winner and supports Ikki's chance.
Congratulates Ikki as a student council ally.

periods.time: During the raid on Dragunov's Shinjuku underground arena
periods.label: 立体高速移动的恋恋

status.current: helps destroy Dragunov's underground arena and recapture escaped criminals
status.condition: shows a new three-dimensional Mach movement technique

periods.summary: Renren joins Hagun students in raiding Dragunov's illegal underground Blazer arena. She announces their special-conscription authority and uses Mach Greed to scatter masses of fighters with sonic booms. Against arena champion Queen, whose twin shields and advance knowledge counter her old linear attacks, Renren reveals Delta Force: a new three-dimensional high-speed movement pattern that lets her run across walls and ceilings and strike from any angle, defeating Queen from above.

key_events.summary: Defeats Queen and clears large numbers of arena fighters with high-speed movement.

periods.label: 黑鸟击碎EDY

status.current: front-line student combatant against U.S. EDY robots

relationships.yuri-oreki: Fights under/alongside Oreki at the first defense line.
relationships.saijou-ikazuchi: Paired C-rank student knight countering EDY units.

periods.summary: Renren is one of the few student knights assigned to the front because she is C-rank. When U.S. EDY robots break through the tanks and ignore Oreki's pain field, Renren uses Black Bird after charging to full effect, demonstrating that strong student knights can destroy EDY units that ordinary soldiers and lower-ranked knights cannot handle.

key_events.summary: Uses Black Bird to destroy EDY robots at the Tokyo Bay defense line.

periods.time: Tokyo Bay front line during PSYON breakthrough
periods.label: 速度中读被超人重创

status.current: survives after being injured on the front line
status.condition: leg broken by an Abraham clone

relationships.saijou-ikazuchi: Classmate who rushes to rescue her and is also defeated.
relationships.yuri-oreki: Teacher who prepares to risk a lethal area technique partly to stop the clones threatening her students.

periods.summary: Renren fights at the Tokyo Bay front and is praised by self-defense troops for her speed. When PSYON breaks through, she charges an Abraham clone with Black Bird, but teleportation and psychokinesis counter her speed. The clone kicks her down and twists her leg until it breaks. Her injury prompts Ikazuchi and Oreki to engage, escalating the local crisis before Kaieda and Kurono intervene.

key_events.summary: Is defeated and maimed by an Abraham clone during the front-line collapse.
